reviews.comment: This is the best professor I have had in my entire time in college. He is very young for a professor, which makes him relate to the students very easily. Tests are easy and straight-forward as long as you study. Show up to class everyday and participate. Take good notes everyday, and you'll be fine.

Prof Pratt is a good lecturer. He keeps the class interesting by providing real world examples. The class overall is basically memorization, the exams are easy as long as you memorize. And its not much information either. The class seems repetitive though with Consumer Behavior (MKTG 322) so im unsure why both are required.

Dr. Pratt is an amazing professor! His class made me so much more interesting in marketing research and he really cares about teaching you with examples. There is a group project that is pretty involved but actually fun if you have a good group.

Professor Pratt is an easy-going, caring, and helpful professor. His class isn't difficult and offers open-note tests. With that said, you should go to class and pay attention to get good notes down to help you for the tests. Professor Pratt even gives you tests reviews, so you do well on the exams. Overall, good class and great professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Interesting material and a fun prof! Majority of class was group discussion that went with the notes. Tests were open note but still a little challenging-mainly applying examples. Projects were meant to help you and were straightforward. Professor Pratt is easy to talk to talk to will grow in his role at A&M! Solid MKTG credit.

He is hands down the best professor ever. He is very laid back and very understanding to any problems you may have. He is new to A&M but still is very open to learning about the school's culture. His exams are straight from his lectures and will give a study guide. He is super nice and has very interesting lectures that make you think differently.
